text: Job Title: AI Engineer Fresher  Job Description: We are looking for a passionate AI Engineer Fresher to join our team and work on real-world machine learning and deep learning applications. Responsibilities: - Develop, train, and optimize machine learning and deep learning models. - Work on computer vision tasks such as object detection and image/video processing. - Collaborate with cross-functional teams to design and implement AI solutions. - Handle data preprocessing, feature engineering, and dataset management. - Participate in system design, testing, and deployment of AI models. - Research and apply new AI/ML techniques to improve system performance. Requirements: - Strong knowledge of Python and AI/ML frameworks such as PyTorch, TensorFlow, or Scikit-learn. - Understanding of deep learning concepts: CNN, RNN, LSTM. - Experience with computer vision tools such as OpenCV or MediaPipe. - Familiarity with data processing libraries: Pandas, NumPy. - Basic knowledge of SQL and working with databases. - Experience working with Git and version control systems. - Good problem-solving skills and teamwork ability. Preferred Qualifications: - Experience in projects related to AI, computer vision, or deep learning. - Knowledge of YOLO or object detection models. - Experience building end-to-end AI systems. - Familiarity with backend or full-stack development is a plus. Education: - Bachelor's degree in Information Technology or related field (or final-year student). Location: - Hanoi, Vietnam

Job Title: Software Engineer (Full-stack / Backend Focus)  Job Description: We are looking for a talented Software Engineer with strong full-stack development skills to build and maintain scalable web applications. The candidate will work on backend systems, APIs, and modern web technologies across multiple platforms. Responsibilities: - Design, develop, and maintain scalable web applications using modern technologies. - Build and optimize backend services using frameworks such as Node.js, Spring Boot, or .NET. - Develop RESTful APIs and handle real-time communication using WebSocket. - Work with databases such as MySQL, SQL Server, and MongoDB. - Collaborate with frontend developers to build responsive and user-friendly interfaces. - Participate in system design, architecture, and performance optimization. - Ensure code quality through testing, debugging, and documentation. - Work with DevOps tools such as Docker for deployment and system integration. Requirements: - Strong programming skills in at least one of the following: Java, C#, JavaScript, or Python. - Experience with backend frameworks such as Spring Boot, ExpressJS, or ASP.NET. - Experience with frontend technologies such as ReactJS, HTML, CSS, and JavaScript. - Familiarity with database systems: MySQL, SQL Server, MongoDB. - Experience with RESTful APIs and real-time systems (WebSocket). - Knowledge of software design principles and system architecture. - Experience with version control tools such as Git. - Good problem-solving skills and teamwork ability. Preferred Qualifications: - Experience with Docker and containerized deployment. - Experience in full-stack development projects. - Familiarity with software development lifecycle and testing methodologies. - Strong understanding of system performance optimization. Education: - Bachelor’s degree in Software Engineering, Computer Science, or related field. Location: - Hanoi, Vietnam

Job Title: Digital Marketing Specialist (SEO & Content Strategy)  Job Description: We are seeking a creative and data-driven Digital Marketing Specialist to develop, implement, and optimize online marketing strategies. The ideal candidate will have strong expertise in SEO, content marketing, social media management, and digital advertising. Responsibilities: - Plan and execute comprehensive digital marketing campaigns across multiple channels. - Develop and manage SEO strategies to improve website ranking and organic traffic. - Create high-quality content for blogs, social media, email marketing, and landing pages. - Analyze campaign performance using tools such as Google Analytics and provide actionable insights. - Manage and optimize paid advertising campaigns (Google Ads, Facebook Ads, etc.). - Collaborate with design and content teams to produce engaging marketing materials. - Monitor market trends, competitor activities, and customer behavior to improve marketing strategies. - Build and maintain brand presence across digital platforms. Requirements: - Strong knowledge of SEO, SEM, and content marketing strategies. - Experience with digital marketing tools such as Google Analytics, Google Ads, Facebook Ads Manager. - Excellent writing and communication skills in English. - Understanding of branding, customer engagement, and conversion optimization. - Experience in social media management and content planning. - Ability to analyze data and generate marketing insights. - Familiarity with marketing automation tools is a plus. Preferred Qualifications: - Experience in running large-scale digital marketing campaigns. - Knowledge of UX/UI principles and customer journey optimization. - Experience with email marketing platforms (Mailchimp, HubSpot, etc.). - Creative mindset with strong attention to detail. Education: - Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Business Administration, or related field. Location: - Hanoi, Vietnam
